case_title: A visual management and augmented-reality-based training module for the enhancement of short and long-term procedural knowledge retention in complex machinery setup
evidence_statement: The paper focuses on the training module to support the development of the worker's training efficacy for the setup of complex machinery. The setup sequence of the machinery is complex.
object_definition: The machinery setup logic is described in section 3.3.2 and involves a sequence of steps for assembling a sub-system of parts.

case_title: A visual management and augmented-reality-based training module for the enhancement of short and long-term procedural knowledge retention in complex machinery setup
evidence_statement: The worker's skills developed through the training are related to the ability to... go on to work autonomously and reliably by preventing potential problems or mistakes (understanding assembly errors).
object_definition: Defined as the ability to recognize and correct errors during the autonomous setup, developed through training.

case_title: A visual management and augmented-reality-based training module for the enhancement of short and long-term procedural knowledge retention in complex machinery setup
evidence_statement: The experiment involved 14 workers, 7 for each group. The participants are company workers who have to manage and maintain a variety of complex machinery and equipment.
object_definition: The participants of the experiment, who are the trainees performing the machinery setup.

case_title: A visual management and augmented-reality-based training module for the enhancement of short and long-term procedural knowledge retention in complex machinery setup
evidence_statement: It is supposed that each group is supported by a trainer during some parts of the test. The trainer is a company veteran who has been qualified to provide operative support to new workers during training.
object_definition: The company veteran qualified to provide operative support and explanations on technical features to the trainees.

case_title: A visual management and augmented-reality-based training module for the enhancement of short and long-term procedural knowledge retention in complex machinery setup
evidence_statement: The confirmation group (G1) has been selected to simulate the training of the machinery setup using the traditional approaches already employed in the company.
object_definition: The baseline training method involving digital PDFs on a screen, supported by visual management, with trainer intervention.

case_title: A visual management and augmented-reality-based training module for the enhancement of short and long-term procedural knowledge retention in complex machinery setup
evidence_statement: This work studied how the combination of Augmented Reality (AR) and Visual Management (VM) supports worker training. The research team proposes to properly combine VM approaches and AR technology to support the company's training process.
object_definition: The newly developed training module that combines VM and AR technologies (HMD) for knowledge retention.

case_title: A visual management and augmented-reality-based training module for the enhancement of short and long-term procedural knowledge retention in complex machinery setup
evidence_statement: The HMD used for the experiment was the Microsoft HoloLens 2. This is used by G2 as the guidance device.
object_definition: The specific head-mounted display hardware used for implementing AR in the training module.

case_title: A visual management and augmented-reality-based training module for the enhancement of short and long-term procedural knowledge retention in complex machinery setup
evidence_statement: For G1, a large-sized smart screen for the visualisation of the digital instructions from the PDF form was located close to the machinery.
object_definition: The technology used for the traditional group, consisting of digital instructions displayed on a screen.

case_title: A visual management and augmented-reality-based training module for the enhancement of short and long-term procedural knowledge retention in complex machinery setup
evidence_statement: To develop the AR application needed for the VMAR-based training module, Unity 2021.3.21 with the 'Microsoft Mixed Reality Toolkit' (MRTK) version 2.8.3 was used.
object_definition: The software application built in Unity that powers the AR experience on the HoloLens 2.

case_title: A visual management and augmented-reality-based training module for the enhancement of short and long-term procedural knowledge retention in complex machinery setup
evidence_statement: Traditional solutions face limitations in terms of interactivity, engagement, adaptability, practical application, feedback mechanisms, cost efficiency, and accessibility.
object_definition: A flaw of traditional training methods, characterized by passive learning rather than active engagement.

case_title: A visual management and augmented-reality-based training module for the enhancement of short and long-term procedural knowledge retention in complex machinery setup
evidence_statement: The analysis demonstrates the inefficacy of traditional approaches in properly supporting the training of complex machinery setups. Considering G1, the total weighted errors increased by 60.0% between session 1 and session 2.
object_definition: The decline in knowledge retention over time, evidenced by the 60% increase in errors for the traditional group after six days.

case_title: A visual management and augmented-reality-based training module for the enhancement of short and long-term procedural knowledge retention in complex machinery setup
evidence_statement: Considering the specific context of the study, the amount of textual information is often high. This is crucial, given that workers may not have a high educational level or may come from a migration background.
object_definition: A limitation of traditional text-heavy training, hindering comprehension for workers with varying educational backgrounds.

case_title: A visual management and augmented-reality-based training module for the enhancement of short and long-term procedural knowledge retention in complex machinery setup
evidence_statement: Extended use (more than 2 h per participant) of the HMD led to: (i) an increased physical and mental workload for the workers, resulting in fatigue.
object_definition: A limitation specifically associated with the extended use of the HMD technology.
